about: The text of the gated MCU images told by who owns it (scripts/lib/text_owner_gate.py, docs/text-ownership.md). Each row holds the image's text and the bytes of every owner of the symbol table of the linked ELF; a change that moves the text or an owner by more than its tolerance moves the row in the same commit, with the reason in `measured`. An owner is the owner of the SYMBOL: code inlined at link time is counted under the symbol that carries it.

zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-28, scripts/kit-lane.sh build on the parity tree at origin's round 3826. The first reading of the owners, from the compare build of run 20261028T005644 (text 176,352), put the single-threaded zenoh-pico image's own code at about 55 KB against about 92 KB of wz's own (wz_session_core, c:wz_, wz_session_mcu, wz_codecs, sce_rust_runtime, wz_runtime_coop, keccak, core, compiler_builtins, wz_runtime_zephyr); the platform (the Zephyr network stack, the board's drivers, the toolchain) is the same size in both. The row first read 174,100 bytes with `keccak` at 2,164, the SHAKE128 permutation of the initial sequence number's derivation (src/initial_sn.rs), which zenoh-pico does not carry; with CONFIG_WZ_INITIAL_SN_COMPACT (this image's overlay turns it on) the permutation is not linked and the text was 171,692. With CONFIG_WZ_SUBSCRIBE=n (the overlay's too) the declaration of a subscriber and the registry that keeps the latest sample of each are not linked: 169,300, 2,392 bytes less, wz_session_core 2,006 of them, and 960 bytes less of bss. The reply writer now writes the responder's identity and an Err itself, so the codec's builder path (ResponseWriter::encode_generic and the heapless::Vec pushes of whole extension entries it makes) is not reachable and not linked when no build feature can stage a timestamp, an attachment or a source info: 167,148, 2,152 bytes less, wz_codecs 1,232 of them. The connect manager's `drive` and `ask` take the planner's call as a trait object, so each is one copy and not one for each of its thirteen callers: 164,488, 2,660 bytes less, c:wz_ (the main function with what it inlines) 2,618 of them. The session's link driver is named by its type (`SessionRuntime::Driver`, `SlotSink<D>`, `TxLease<D>`) where the image's Kconfig chose it, so the session's calls through the link are direct calls the compiler inlines and not calls through a trait object's table: 162,784, 1,704 bytes less (wz_session_core 922 of them). The receive hands a lent record to the sink's `record` and not to the one `event` that also carries the turn's own events, and the layers send a query or a put of their own only on the latter: 162,216, 568 bytes less (wz_runtime_coop 796 of them). The rows of the rounds that followed moved the text by less than the tolerance and were not moved with it; this row is the image of 2026-10-29: the connect manager's actions are one buffer that `drive` fills through `ask` and `take` reads in place, and its rows are put in the list's order in place and not taken out and built again (wz_session_mcu 1,068 bytes less), the peer entry is built as the call's result, and the session's parameters are made by the slot: 161,344 in all. 160,356 on 2026-10-29 with the node's set-up and its loop as two functions (`ClientNode::start`, inlined into the image's own `start`, and `RunningNode::drive`): the main function was 3,594 bytes and is 188, `c:wz_` (the main function with what it inlined) 3,748 bytes less, and the code it held is under its own owners now (wz_session_mcu 4,044 more, wz_zephyr_admin_node 1,228 new, wz_session_core 1,106 less and wz_runtime_coop 1,156 less, each of which the loop inlines into itself now that it is not one function with the set-up): 424 bytes less in all than the image before. 153,868 on 2026-10-29 with the receive of a Push and of a Response, a ResponseFinal not read (`rx-push`, `rx-response`): the client that only answers declares no subscriber and asks no query, so no router sends it those kinds; wz_session_core 4,044 bytes less and wz_codecs 2,386 less (the decoders only those kinds reached; which symbols was not listed), 6,488 bytes less in all, and 640 bytes of bss. 148,948 on 2026-10-29 with the control records of a peer not read either (`rx-control`: the Declare, the Interest and the Oam; this client sends no Interest, so a router declares nothing to it, and it holds no token and takes no session): wz_session_core 3,488 bytes less and wz_codecs 1,354 less, 4,920 bytes less in all. 147,772 on 2026-10-29 with the retry wait grown in integer arithmetic (`retry_period::grown_ms`: the soft-float multiply, the two conversions and the two comparisons of `(delay as f64 * factor) as u64` are not linked, compiler_builtins 1,238 bytes less and the integer code 558 more: 680 bytes less, within the tolerance and not moved then) and the endpoint text read in one byte scan (`dial::parse_endpoint` and `dial::decimal`, 886 bytes to 386: 496 bytes less). 147,556 on 2026-10-30 with the compiler runtime's `__aeabi_memclr` (208 bytes beside the libc `memset`) answered by `memset` (216 bytes less, within the tolerance and not moved then). 146,204 with the runtime taking no interrupt lock (`CONFIG_WZ_SINGLE_CONTEXT`, which this image's overlay turns on: the `irq_lock` and `irq_unlock` calls at about 130 borrows of the runtime's and the session's cells are not in the image; wz_session_core 506 bytes less, wz_session_mcu 678, wz_runtime_coop 144): 1,352 bytes less. 149,336 on 2026-10-30 with the SCE pin at b1ede72108, which links the engine's Appendix D once for the program: 3,132 bytes more, sce_rust_runtime 7,908 to 9,512 (the two machines' copies of 3,586 and 3,946 bytes are one core of 6,502 and two shells of 1,286 and 1,724), the symbol-less rodata (the documents' tables) 4,401 to 5,045, wz_session_core 432 more, wz_codecs 208 more and sce_forge_runtime 162 more (the codecs that may refuse an encode return a Result). 146,212 on 2026-10-30 with the SCE pin at f167223931 (packed table rows, the engine taking events and states as numbers, its constructor and exit walk out of line): 3,124 bytes less than at b1ede72108 (149,336) and 8 more than before the engine's Appendix D was linked once (146,204 at 49e40c9a72); sce_rust_runtime is 7,398 where it was 9,512 at b1ede72108 and 7,908 for the two machines' copies. 144,724 on 2026-10-30 with the SCE pin at 44e6d3083b and CONFIG_WZ_REQUEST_PUT_DEL off (the Put and Del arms of a Request's body are not compiled: zenoh 1.10.1 takes only a Query there, SCE ADR 0072): 1,488 bytes less than with the arms (146,212 at f167223931) and 1,480 less than before the engine's Appendix D was linked once (146,204 at 49e40c9a72); wz_session_core is 418 bytes less and the two body decoders (MsgPutView and MsgDelView, which only the Request decode reached) are not linked. 144,220 on 2026-10-30 with the board hooks answering `__aeabi_memclr4`, `__aeabi_memclr8` and `__aeabi_memset8` (and `__aeabi_memset`, `__aeabi_memset4`, which this image does not call) with the libc `memset`: 504 bytes less than with the compiler runtime's copies (144,724), which were three loops of 174, 174 and 184 bytes and are now stubs of 8, 8 and 10; 1,984 less than before the engine's Appendix D was linked once (146,204 at 49e40c9a72). 144,172 on 2026-10-30 with three frames brought down (`reconcile` ordering the rows by swaps of neighbours, the log functions filling one buffer, the receive's reading of a handshake message out of line from the frame that gives the engine the event): 48 bytes less than before (144,220) and 2,032 less than before the engine's Appendix D was linked once (146,204 at 49e40c9a72). 143,356 on 2026-10-30 with the send's dispatch (`dispatch_network_message_at`) one copy that calls the message's encoder through a pointer, where the slot profile had a copy for each kind of message with the encoder inlined in it (three copies of 1,334, 810 and 632 bytes, and one now): 816 bytes less than before (144,172) and 2,848 less than before the engine's Appendix D was linked once (146,204 at 49e40c9a72). 142,784 on 2026-10-31 with the SCE pin at b2ff4da1cb: every machine of the image is built under a session id proven when it is compiled (`new_with_checked_session_id`; the run-time check of the id and its `character_at` scan are no longer linked, and the wrapper that dropped the refusal is gone) and the engine keeps its per-turn state in its shared core. 572 bytes less than before (143,356); the three images of this lane each fell by the same 572. 142,768 on 2026-10-31 with the batch the session negotiates stated at 1,024 bytes (CONFIG_WZ_BATCH_BYTES), the reply payload limit at 96 and the session machine's queues declared at 16 events (`sce:capacity`): 16 bytes less than before (142,784). The memory these state is in the .bss, which fell 1,600 bytes. 142,672 on 2026-10-31 with the SCE pin at 98803c0bc8 (ADR 0075: a machine keeps a delayed-send queue and a donedata slot only when its document fills them; neither of the client's two documents does): 96 bytes less than before (142,768). The memory the two machines no longer hold is in the .bss, which fell 1,584 bytes (104,578 to 102,994). 142,576 on 2026-10-31 with the SCE pin at 11e90bcd77 (the unknown-tag codec, moved by another session): 96 bytes less than before (142,672). 142,528 on 2026-10-31 with the SCE pin at dc579571aa (ADR 0076: a machine's internal queue is sized by the depth the generator proves from its document, 0 for both of the client's, and its external queue by `sce:capacity`, 2 for the session machine): 48 bytes less than before (142,576). The memory is in the .bss, which fell 160 bytes (102,994 to 102,834). On 2026-11-02, with the lifecycle rounds of 2026-11-01 built in (D10, D12, D15), the text reads 143,420 bytes on the lab host's build of 2026-11-02 evening (143,308 earlier that day; the later commits of other sessions added 112), 892 more than the row held, so the row is moved to it and the .bss 102,866 (32 more), data 1,524, in the build of the board's own configuration (`kit-lane.sh build`). The run arena is the same 832 bytes as before: a build of the crates' own default limits needs more, which is what the no-allocator census had read as an outgrown arena (see `FIXED_CLIENT_LIMITS` in scripts/lib/no_allocator_link_gate.py). 148,884 on 2026-11-05 (.bss 103,074, data 1,524) with the SCE pin at 07cb8c5020 (see the asking client's row): 664 bytes less than the row held, all of it in wz_codecs (5,424 to 4,240). 2026-11-18, on the tree that repays hosted run 44032688827 (Layer Qzk, last green at ef49dc9911): 148,884 to 155,796 bytes. Symbol diff of zephyr-client-fixed against ef49dc9911 (+6,998 over 96 symbols): `core::net` address parsing (`Parser::read_ipv4_addr` +762, `read_number` +458, `read_ipv6_addr` +278) and the locator text of either family (`Locator::text` +680, `dial::parse_locator` +442, `text_out::push_groups` +286), the handshake's receive (`parse_open` +462, `decode_keep_alive` +384, `parse_close` +346, `parse_init` +240) and the request's view admission (+482, with `RequestView::decode_into` +574 against `lend_request` -1,008); chosen growth of the dual-family link seam (b1e54be25b, 9f169a0b0e) and the receive's checks, so the row is the reading. 143,720 on 2026-11-21 (Layer Qzk on the lab host at a12702273), 12,076 bytes less than the row. The text was taken back in four rounds once the pico ceiling (docs/upstream-parity.md, D8) read the clients as a LOSS; each commit is named with the symbols it aims at, read in the image before it, and the rounds were not measured one by one (the compare build of the fixed client read 149,676 after the second). First: 237d8811f (a UDP link writes its ends' locator text only when first asked), d3bd60360 (the four handshake decodes share one out-of-line entry keeper), bd2d89562 (an endpoint is read in the families its stack opens, IPv4 text by a one-pass reader held to core's answers). Second: bd95a7c40 (a plain reply is counted by its direct layout, not by the codec's counting encoder), 4b785ef31 (a no-heap session writes each kind it declares through that kind: `LentDeclaration::encoded_len`, 1,476, and the encoders of the kinds a build never declares). Third: a65e026f6 (the connect retry schedule is a build constant: `RetryPeriod::next_ms`, 522, and its rounding, 372), 8b3943126 (a pending reply row holds its side-bands only where they are sent: `stage_parts`, 936). Fourth: 0f66f1cad (the registry calls a closed queryable sink with the view and the responder as their own types: the `ReplyOut` table of `QueryResponder` and the methods only it reached, and the `ProvenQuery` table), 34f65d3b6 (a build with no room for nodes names a node by no value: the node paths of the connect manager's `reconcile`, `dial_peer` and `observe` and of the planner's `perform` and `dial_ended`, `first_dialable`, and a key of one byte where it was seventeen). The owners that moved past the tolerance: wz_session_core 33,638 to 28,818, wz_session_mcu 12,302 to 10,126, wz_codecs 4,956 to 2,390, core 2,908 to 1,404; the others stayed within it and were not re-read. In the same run the pico ceiling reads the compare build at 144,820 bytes of text against single-threaded zenoh-pico's 147,912: WIN by 3,092 (flash 3,188, static RAM 9,333, stack objects 3,456), where it was a LOSS by 1,764 after the second round.
